title: Cajole
html_source:
To cajole means to persuade/coax someone into doing something by being overly flattering or making many promises to them.

Stephen feels like his classmates are so easily manipulated and hypocrites because they blindly follow the faith with their “dull piety”.

They are nothing but “religious” puppets to Stephen.
